We are pleased to announce a release candidate for pandas ${BASE_VERSION}.

See the [whatsnew](https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/version/${MINOR_VERSION}/whatsnew/v${BASE_VERSION}.html) for a list of all the changes.

The release can be installed from PyPI:

    python -m pip install --upgrade --pre pandas==${VERSION}

Or from conda-forge

    conda install -c conda-forge/label/pandas_rc pandas==${VERSION}

Please report any issues with the release candidate on the [pandas issue tracker](https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues).

Thanks to all the contributors who made this release possible.
